prompt: I need to build an AI chat component in Angular 21 that streams responses from an LLM API at /api/chat/stream. The user types a message, clicks send, and the response should appear token by token as it streams in. I also need to keep a chat history that accumulates across multiple messages. Please show me the full component with the template.

assertions.text: Uses resource() with the stream property for streaming responses
Uses ResourceStreamItem signal pattern inside the stream function
Separates user input signal from submitted prompt signal (no fetch on keystroke)
Uses linkedSignal to accumulate chat history across multiple responses
Template shows loading state while streaming
Template displays error state with retry option
